name: plants
summary: Every plant in trays, planters and stations, read from the plant itself: stage, maturity, health, problems, time to harvest. Short by default; verbose or reference_id gives a plant in full. Lists 15. Read only.

help.text: In short: reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, planted, tray, stage, stage_count, maturity_ratio, ready_to_harvest, dead, health_percent, problems and harvest_in_s. Works for trays with no data port. include_unplanted adds harvested crops and seed bags. Times are game seconds, efficiency parts are multipliers, temperatures kelvin.

full.summary: What a plant in full reports.
full.text: Growth stage (index, count, first mature and seeding stages, progress and length of the current stage, every stage's length); mature, seeding, dead, ready to harvest; growth efficiency and its parts (breathing, temperature, hydration, pressure, light); problems in plain words (dry, too cold, harmful gas); each condition's time_s against the time after which it starts damaging the plant; damage per type with damage_ratio (0 unharmed, 1 dead) and health_percent; harvest and seed counts with a forecast of the next harvest from recorded stress; nutrition, fertiliser, light exposure, the air it breathes, its tray's water.

needs.text: needs: ideal and survivable temperature_k and pressure_kpa, gases taken in (mol_per_tick) with the share of the air each needs, water_mol_per_tick, light and dark seconds per day, and harmful gas limits. Forecasts at the current efficiency: seconds to the next stage, to harvest, to seeds and, for perennials, to regrow after a harvest (null when it is not growing).

reference_id.description: One plant (find_items, or container_contents of its tray); left out, every plant.

include_unplanted.description: Also list plant items not planted: crops in lockers, seed bags. Default false.

verbose.description: Every plant in full, as one plant is given. Default false.
